messages.author: 6f2794c4c7fe16c7
messages.subject: Standard errors for std.lv estimates
parts:
Hi there,


I am running a SEM model using the lavaan package and would like to obtain the estimates for the standardized latent variables (std.lv). I would like to get the standard errors for the std.lv estimates from the regressions.  I have been unable to get any sensible standard errors for these.

 

When I run command a) and b) I get standard errors for the unstandardized estimates.

When I run command c) I get standard errors for the std.all estimates.

When I run command d) I get the standard errors, z, p-value, lower confidence interval and upper confidence interval reported as NA.

a)       summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)

b)      summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

c)       standardizedSolution(fit)

d)      standardizedSolution(fit, type = "std.lv")

 

I have provided some example code below, using one of the datasets with lavaan.  Please could anyone advise why the standard errors are provided for 

the std.all and not the std.lv, and if there is a way to get the standard errors for the std.lv estimates.


Many thanks

Kirsty

 

******* Example code *******

 

library("lavaan")

 

model <- '

# latent variable definitions

ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3

dem60 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4

dem65 =~ y5 + y6 + y7 + y8

 

# regressions

dem60 ~ ind60

dem65 ~ ind60 + dem60

 

'

 

fit <- sem(model, data = PoliticalDemocracy)

 

summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)

summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

 

standardizedSolution(fit)

standardizedSolution(fit, type = "std.lv")

messages.subject: Re: Standard errors for std.lv estimates
parts:
> Please could anyone advise why the standard errors are provided for
> the std.all and not the std.lv, and if there is a way to get the
> standard errors for the std.lv estimates.

You found a bug!

This is now fixed in dev lavaan 0.6-7.1561.

Very few users seem to use type = "std.lv" explicitly.

Yves.
